theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a premium mobile personal finance tracker, we pivot away from 'corporate blue' and 'fintech-bro dark mode'. We embrace an Organic & Earthy palette (bone-white, sand, forest green, terracotta) to signal financial health as organic growth, reducing anxiety and building trust.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E3F32] text-[#F9F8F6] rounded-full py-4 px-8 font-semibold hover:bg-[#2A5243] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F2EFEA] text-[#2C2A29] rounded-full py-4 px-8 font-semibold hover:bg-[#E3DFD7] transition-colors

cards.base_style: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(44,42,41,0.04)] border border-[#E3DFD7]/50
cards.dashboard_balance_card: bg-[#1E3F32] rounded-3xl p-8 text-[#F9F8F6] shadow-xl overflow-hidden relative

inputs.style: bg-[#F9F8F6] border border-[#E3DFD7] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[#2C2A29] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E3F32]/20 focus:border-[#1E3F32] transition-all

bottom_tab_navigation.style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#E3DFD7]/50 pt-4 pb-8 px-6 flex justify-between items-center rounded-t-3xl

icons_and_visuals.visual_enhancers: Use pill-shaped status badges, soft gradients on milestone achievements, and organic shapes for empty states.

image_urls.description: Minimalist sand dune texture. Use as a soft, organic background element for the Onboarding screens or Empty States.
Professional smiling man. Use for the user profile avatar in the Dashboard header and Profile tab.

accessibility_and_interactions.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, transaction list items) MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="add-transaction-button"`).
accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Ensure text color contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. The deep forest green (#1E3F32) provides excellent contrast against bone-white (#F9F8F6).
accessibility_and_interactions.motion: Use smooth transitions (e.g., `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`) for button presses and card expands. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile app (Expo React Native). Since this app uses React Native, translate these Tailwind classes to NativeWind classes, or adapt to standard StyleSheet properties where NativeWind is unavailable.
Do NOT use generic blue colors. Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette defined in this document.
For the AI Insights tab, use subtle moss green (#4A7059) highlights to indicate positive financial anomalies, and terracotta (#C85A40) for spending warnings. Do not use standard yellow/red alerts.
Implement the bottom tab bar with a floating or rounded-top glassmorphism effect.
Dashboard must utilize the 'Bento Grid' approach, making widgets feel like distinct, physical, rounded blocks rather than flat endless lists.
For icons, install and use Phosphor icons package compatible with React Native.
Use standard Expo router for navigation and ensure all interactive elements have appropriate test IDs.
